selection: 2000 SHA256 iterations, 1500 total target messages/s, 3 consumers
reason: The isolated task takes 1.70, 3.44 and 2.22 ms/message on the initial three consumers. Equal partition input implies about 500 messages/s per consumer; at least the slower consumers may accumulate backlog. Six consumers would average about 250 messages/s each, below isolated capacities. These estimates omit pipeline overhead and are not throughput results.

qualification.sustained_growth: Positive backlog growth in both 60-second evaluation windows; each window median of final 10 seconds minus initial 10 seconds exceeds 1500 offsets.
qualification.evidence: No identity/evidence/delivery/processing failures; unfinished outcomes remain reportable, not grounds for favorable selection.
